verdict.rationale: MX's Connect Widget is a drop-in hosted flow embeddable via Web SDK or React Native SDK that prompts end users to authenticate with their institution, and the Platform API/webhooks allow server-side session creation and retrieval of a connected 'member' token without building institution UI. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration of the exact server-side session-create-then-open-widget-then-get-token sequence, and no explicit third-party account confirming ease of integration.
